Cabo Fishing Tournaments: The Ultimate 2026–2027 Guide

Los Cabos is one of the world's most celebrated sportfishing destinations, attracting anglers from around the globe to compete in prestigious fishing tournaments.

Every year, Cabo San Lucas and the surrounding waters of Baja California Sur host exciting competitions targeting blue marlin, black marlin, striped marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), and wahoo.

From the legendary Bisbee's Black & Blue to the popular Cabo Tuna Jackpot, these events combine world-class fishing, competitive excitement, and unforgettable experiences on the water.

Whether you're an experienced tournament angler or planning your first competitive fishing adventure, understanding the tournament calendar is an important part of preparing your trip.

Major Cabo Fishing Tournaments in 2026 and 2027

1. Pelagic Cabo Triple Crown of Fishing

2027 Dates: June 10–13

Fishing Days: June 11–12, 2027

2027 General Entry: $3,000 USD per team

The Pelagic Cabo Triple Crown of Fishing brings competitive excitement to Los Cabos during the summer fishing season.

Teams compete across four categories:

  • Billfish catch and release

  • Tuna

  • Dorado (mahi-mahi)

  • Wahoo

Unlike tournaments focusing exclusively on marlin, the Triple Crown rewards teams targeting multiple offshore game fish.

The competition includes two fishing days, with awards recognizing outstanding performances across the different divisions.

For 2027, organizers have announced a $2,000 early-registration rate through April 1, alongside the standard $3,000 general entry. Optional jackpots are available at additional cost.

Why anglers love it: Multiple species, different competitive divisions, and the opportunity to experience summer sportfishing in Los Cabos.

Official tournament information: Pelagic Triple Crown

2. Bisbee's East Cape Offshore Tournament

2026 Dates: July 28 – August 1

2026 Base Entry: $1,500 USD per team

2027 Dates: To be announced

Held in the East Cape region of Baja California Sur, Bisbee's East Cape Offshore combines serious sportfishing competition with a more relaxed atmosphere.

The tournament attracts teams targeting marlin, tuna, and dorado in productive offshore waters.

Although the atmosphere is different from the larger October tournaments in Cabo San Lucas, the competition can still be intense, with substantial optional jackpot opportunities.

Why anglers love it: A distinctive East Cape experience, competitive offshore fishing, and multiple award categories.

Official tournament information: Bisbee's East Cape Offshore

3. Los Cabos Billfish Tournament

2026 Dates: October 7–11

2026 Base Entry: $2,500 USD per team

2027 Dates: To be announced

The Los Cabos Billfish Tournament traditionally opens the exciting October tournament season.

It attracts experienced anglers pursuing some of the most impressive game fish in the Pacific and Sea of Cortez.

Competition categories include marlin, billfish releases, and offshore species such as yellowfin tuna, wahoo, and dorado.

The tournament also recognizes individual fishing achievements and offers optional jackpot opportunities.

An important feature of its 2026 rules was the inclusion of starting locations in both Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo.

Why anglers love it: Diverse competitive categories, exciting billfish action, and the opportunity to participate in a prestigious annual Cabo fishing event.

Official tournament information: Los Cabos Billfish Tournament

4. Bisbee's Los Cabos Offshore Tournament

2026 Dates: October 12–17

2026 Base Entry: $1,500 USD per team

2027 Dates: To be announced

Often nicknamed the "Little Bisbee's," the Los Cabos Offshore Tournament has developed into a major sportfishing competition.

Held shortly before the famous Black & Blue, it brings together anglers pursuing billfish, tuna, and dorado.

With different competition categories and optional jackpots, the event offers a combination of strategic fishing, excitement, and camaraderie.

For many anglers, it is an opportunity to experience tournament fishing before the region's highest-profile marlin competition.

Why anglers love it: Multiple fishing divisions, a lively tournament atmosphere, and the excitement of competing during Cabo's peak tournament season.

Official tournament information: Bisbee's Los Cabos Offshore

5. Bisbee's Black & Blue Marlin Tournament

2026 Dates: October 19–24

Fishing Days: October 21–23, 2026

2026 Base Entry: $5,000 USD per team

2027 Dates: To be announced

The Bisbee's Black & Blue is one of the most prestigious and financially significant sportfishing tournaments in the world.

Every October, experienced anglers gather in Cabo San Lucas hoping to encounter massive blue and black marlin.

The event has built an international reputation for extraordinary competition, impressive catches, and substantial prize payouts.

Success requires careful planning, fishing experience, suitable equipment, and the ability to adapt to changing ocean conditions.

Although impressive prize pools attract worldwide attention, fishing success is never guaranteed.

Why anglers love it: Legendary marlin fishing, international competition, and one of the most recognizable events in professional sportfishing.

Official tournament information: Bisbee's Black & Blue

6. Western Outdoor News Cabo Tuna Jackpot

2026 Dates: November 4–7

Fishing Days: November 5–6, 2026

2027 Dates: To be announced

The Western Outdoor News Cabo Tuna Jackpot is one of Los Cabos' most popular annual tuna fishing tournaments.

The main attraction is the opportunity to compete for impressive yellowfin tuna, a species prized for its strength, endurance, and powerful runs.

Over two fishing days, participating teams pursue qualifying catches, with optional jackpot categories offering additional competitive opportunities.

The tournament combines serious fishing with an energetic social atmosphere, making it a memorable event for participants and spectators.

Why anglers love it: Exciting tuna fishing, a competitive atmosphere, and the opportunity to experience Los Cabos during an important period of the offshore fishing season.

Official tournament information: Cabo Tuna Jackpot

Choosing the Right Cabo Fishing Tournament

Each Los Cabos tournament offers a different experience.

Anglers focused on large marlin may be particularly interested in the Bisbee's Black & Blue or the Los Cabos Billfish Tournament.

Those interested in multiple offshore species may prefer the Pelagic Triple Crown or Bisbee's Los Cabos Offshore.

For anglers passionate about powerful yellowfin tuna, the Cabo Tuna Jackpot offers a competition centered on one of the region's most exciting game fish.

Choosing the right event depends on your target species, experience, budget, tournament rules, and preferred travel dates.

Planning Your Tournament Fishing Experience

Before registering for a Cabo fishing tournament, consider several important factors:

  • Tournament rules: Each organizer establishes its own fishing boundaries, qualifying species, equipment requirements, and scoring procedures.

  • Registration fees: Base entry fees and optional jackpots are separate expenses.

  • Fishing boat requirements: Confirm that your selected vessel meets the tournament's eligibility and safety requirements.

  • Fishing licenses: All participating anglers must meet applicable Mexican fishing regulations.

  • Starting locations: Tournament departure and starting-line procedures may differ from regular private fishing charters.

  • Weather conditions: Ocean conditions can influence fishing opportunities and may result in schedule changes.

Tournament entry fees do not automatically include fishing boat charter costs, fishing licenses, fuel, bait, or other services.

Always confirm the latest dates, rules, registration costs, and tournament requirements directly with the event organizer before booking your trip.

Frequently Asked Questions About Cabo Fishing Tournaments

When is fishing tournament season in Cabo San Lucas?

Major fishing tournaments take place at different times throughout the year, with particularly important events during the summer and fall. October is especially well known for its marlin tournaments, while November features the popular Cabo Tuna Jackpot.

What fish are targeted in Cabo fishing tournaments?

Depending on the event, qualifying species may include blue marlin, black marlin, striped marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado, wahoo, and other billfish.

Each competition has its own eligibility rules and minimum qualifying requirements.

How much does it cost to enter a Cabo fishing tournament?

Tournament registration fees vary considerably.

Published 2026 base entries for major Los Cabos events ranged from $1,500 to $5,000 USD per team. Optional jackpots, boat charter costs, and additional services are separate.

Always verify current fees with the organizer.

Can I participate in a tournament while staying in San José del Cabo?

Potentially, yes. Some events permit participation from San José del Cabo or have procedures for boats departing from different marinas.

However, tournament participation depends on each organizer's rules, starting-line requirements, and vessel eligibility.

Can I book a fishing boat for a Cabo tournament?

Fishing boat options may be available for tournament dates, subject to availability, suitability, and the specific competition's requirements.

Contact Exotic Fish Cabo to discuss your preferred event and fishing plans.
